shellCommands.command:
npm run start -- -p 3999 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3
curl -s http://localhost:3999/ | head -40
echo "----ABOUT----"
curl -s http://localhost:3999/about | head -40
pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "npm run start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; jobs -l 2>/dev/null; echo done
pgrep -fa "next-server|next start" || echo "no next server running"
find app -type f | sort && echo "---" && git status --short
